headline: Going Commando reaches 65.83% matched code on USA v1.01
summary: Going Commando's progress report puts USA v1.01 at 65.83% matched code by size, with 7,100 of 8,578 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The final progress commit also records 6,646 of 8,634 functions for USA v2.00 and 4,979 of 8,672 for PAL.
highlights: bigbeno37's #368 brings 842 functions from a fork, covering 609,116 code bytes on USA v1.01. Its 73,572 additions and 59,161 deletions dominate the day's line counts.
Reviewed integration retains 15 new C functions on USA v1.01, while one proposed function remains a near miss after review (#366).
Parallel builds give each simultaneous program its own Wine prefix, avoiding a shared assembler and linker bottleneck.
The linked-code counter now sums complete compilation units rather than waiting for the entire game to match (#369). This is separate from matched-code coverage.
Object-slot lookup and held-item work remain open proposals (#370, #371).
